explanation: Nutmeg is the seed inside the apricot-like fruit of the nutmeg tree, and mace is the lacy red covering, the aril, wrapped around it. Mace turns orange as it dries.

claims.text: Nutmeg and mace both come from the fruit of the nutmeg tree, Myristica fragrans.
Nutmeg is the seed of the fruit, and mace is the aril, a lacy red covering around the seed.
Mace is red when fresh and dries to an orange or yellow-brown colour.
